check: East and west of the drawn volume against the sky, at Betelgeuse’s default view
method: Headless Chromium, 1200 x 1000 px at device scale 1, the local dev server, /betelgeuse/?dataset=matisse and ?dataset=sio-2023 with the same default camera, 12 s after load, shell hidden. The SiO light is what the SiO frame adds in green and blue over the MATISSE frame outside 1.2 disc radii; its weighted centroid is compared with the screen angle the default-view test pins for the SiO ring’s east-south-east weight (celestial north 42 degrees counterclockwise of screen-right, east 90 degrees beyond it, weight at position angle 122).
